categories.main_business_segments: The company operates as a network energy solution provider with three main business segments: (1) Wireless network energy products for 5G base stations and communication infrastructure, including integrated cabinets, power supplies, and lithium batteries; (2) Data center products including intelligent micro-modules, closed-loop cooling systems, and IDC cabinets; (3) Fixed and transmission network products including optical cable junction boxes and passive optical devices. The company has recently expanded into energy storage business including household and commercial energy storage systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include high-efficiency power conversion topology using Totem PFC and DSP digital control with peak conversion efficiency of 97.5%, natural heat dissipation technology, wireless monitoring technology with 4G full-network communication capability, multi-machine parallel technology with current balancing less than 5%, and intelligent battery management modules. For lithium batteries, the company developed industry-leading 100Ah ultra-thin battery cells (2U height) and phosphate iron lithium batteries with wide temperature operating range (-40°C to 60°C for communications, -20°C to 65°C for energy storage) and long cycle life (2000+ cycles for communications, 6000+ cycles for energy storage). Manufacturing is conducted through owned facilities in Shenzhen and Huizhou, plus international facilities in Thailand and Finland.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include China's three major telecom operators (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom), China Tower Corporation, and international ICT equipment manufacturers (Ericsson and Nokia). The company serves base station construction, data center infrastructure, and increasingly the energy storage market. End markets include telecommunications infrastructure, data centers, industrial energy management, and household energy storage applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant international presence. Domestic operations cover over 30 provincial sales liaison offices across all major Chinese telecom operator markets. International operations include manufacturing and R&D facilities in Finland (Fi-Systems Oy), Sweden (Efore AB), Thailand (Efore Telecom Thailand), and Suzhou, China. The company has established global distribution networks and serves customers across Europe and other international markets, with international revenue representing 39.73% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the telecommunications and energy infrastructure supply chain. It manufactures integrated network energy solutions and components for base stations and data centers, positioning itself between component suppliers (raw materials, electronic components, sheet metal) and end customers (telecom operators, ICT equipment manufacturers, data center operators). The company also increasingly operates in the downstream consumer energy storage market through distribution channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Advancing 5G network energy solutions with focus on energy efficiency, space optimization, and intelligent management; (2) Developing data center energy solutions aligned with green and low-carbon requirements; (3) Expanding energy storage business including household and commercial storage systems; (4) Pursuing international market expansion through ODM partnerships and distribution channels; (5) Integrating AI and digital technologies for smart energy management; (6) Developing virtual power plant (VPP) and intelligent operation and maintenance capabilities. R&D investment was 13.78% of revenue in 2024.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of network energy products and solutions to telecom operators and ICT equipment manufacturers via competitive bidding processes. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products. For international markets, the company uses project-based development cooperation models with framework contracts and ongoing purchase orders. The company is expanding into energy storage through agent and distributor channels. Revenue model is product-based with system-level integrated solutions commanding premium pricing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global network energy solution providers and traditional power equipment manufacturers. Key international competitors include established ICT equipment suppliers. The company differentiates through: (1) Integrated one-stop network energy solutions combining cabinets, power supplies, batteries, and cooling; (2) Strong relationships with Chinese telecom operators through 20 years of market presence; (3) Simultaneous qualification as global supplier to both Ericsson and Nokia; (4) Advanced lithium battery technology and energy storage capabilities; (5) Rapid customer response capability and multi-level direct marketing in China. The company holds a mid-to-upper tier position in the domestic market with growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized telecommunications equipment manufacturer with 2024 revenue of RMB 556.96 million (8.72% growth from 2023's RMB 512.30 million). However, the company reported a net loss of RMB 205.77 million in 2024 (compared to RMB 223.66 million loss in 2023), primarily due to delayed customer projects, energy storage business losses during market expansion phase, and depreciation/operating costs of the 5G intelligent industrial park subsidiary. Total assets reached RMB 1.568 billion at year-end 2024. The company completed a RMB 523.81 million capital raise in January 2024 through specific object issuance.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on providing integrated, green, and intelligent network energy solutions that reduce installation space, improve energy efficiency, and lower total cost of ownership. Key differentiators include: (1) Industry-first 100Ah ultra-thin battery cells reducing installation space by 33-50% compared to traditional designs; (2) One-stop integrated solutions combining cabinets, power supplies, batteries, and cooling in single systems; (3) Advanced energy efficiency technologies including high-conversion-efficiency power modules and intelligent thermal management; (4) Smart monitoring and remote management capabilities through 4G/5G connectivity; (5) Comprehensive product certifications (Taiertec, UN, IEC, UL) and international customer validation; (6) Expanding energy storage capabilities supporting virtual power plants and demand response; (7) Rapid response capability and customized solutions tailored to customer-specific requirements.
